"''They've sliced the platform.|Sarria and Eurus report to Mother Aniseya|}} '''Sarria''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Gender|female]] [[witch]] who served as a [[scout]] and [[warrior]] in the [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[148 BBY]], Sarria observed a lesson that Mother Aniseya taught the [[Youngling|young]] [[twin]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] in the [[Brendok fortress|coven's fortress]] and then chaperoned the children to their room when the lesson ended. Later that [[Local day|night]], Sarria and the witch [[Eurus]] interrupted the twins' [[Rite of Ascension]] to warn Mother Aniseya and the others that a group of [[Jedi]] had sliced the coven's lift platform. The Jedi then [[Mission to Brendok|entered]] the fortress and gained Mother Aniseya's permission to test the twins potential to become Jedi the following [[Standard day|day]]. Sarria and several other scouts then accompanied the twins and Mother [[Koril]] to the test, which Verosha passed and Mae-ho failed. Koril, who hoped to prevent Verosha from leaving with the Jedi, later had the scouts arm themselves. When the Jedi [[Sol]] and [[Torbin]] arrived at the fortress they were confronted by Koril and Mother Aniseya as Sarria and the other scouts stood on a catwalk overhead with bows ready. After Mae-ho entered the courtyard and cried out for help with a [[fire]] she had started, Sol [[Death|killed]] Mother Aniseya as he saw her transform into black smoke. Sarria opened fire on Torbin alongside the other archers as Koril attacked Sol, but after Koril was disarmed she too turned to smoke and Sarria and the archers vanished. Sol and Torbin were then forced to fight their colleague [[Kelnacca]], who had been possessed by the coven, but once [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] freed him from possession many of the witches perished. The Jedi then left Brendok with Verosha. ==Biography== ===Coven security=== {{Quote|Put down your weapons. No violence.|Mother Aniseya gives an order to Sarria and the warriors|}} Sarria was a [[humanoid]] [[scout]] and [[warrior]]{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{AD|Disney+}} for an exiled [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es that lived in an all-[[Gender|female]] community in a [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[148 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]]" states that the events of the four Jedi ([[Indara]], [[Kelnacca]], [[Sol]], and [[Torbin]]) stationed on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]]'s burning of the [[Brendok coven]] takes place sixteen years prior to the events of the show, placing all subsequent events of this episode in [[148 BBY]]. Sarria attended a training session for the [[Youngling|young]] [[twin]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] in the fortress's common room and sat on the room's steps as an observer. During the lesson, the coven's leader, [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]], demonstrated [[the Force]] and how it was most powerful when used together rather then by an individual. The twins were distracted until Aniseya used the Force to [[Telekinesis|knock]] them to the ground, with only Mae-ho blocking a second attempt while Verosha hid behind her sister. After Mother [[Koril]] admonished Verosha for hiding, both Mothers' attention was drawn by a sound coming from the fortress's [[power generator]] in the adjoining space. Mother Aniseya then ordered the twins to their room, and Sarria stood to chaperone the children away as the Mothers investigated the disturbance. That [[Local day|night]], the twins' [[Rite of Ascension]] was held in a [[Rite of Ascension courtyard|courtyard]] at the base of the fortress. After Mae-ho had completed her asscension, Sarria and fellow coven member [[Eurus]] entered the courtyard and interrupted proceedings before Verosha could ascend in order to warn Mother Aniseya that a group of [[Jedi]] who had been [[Mission to Brendok|visiting]] Brendok had [[Slicer|sliced]] the coven's lift platform to gain entry to the fortress.{{Acolyte|Choice}} Mother Aniseya ordered the coven to hide the twins and Eurus and others gathered around the children to conceal them as Sarria and several other [[warrior]]s drew their [[bow]]s in preparation for the Jedi's arrival. Mother Aniseya ordered Sarria and the others to lower their weapons, which they did just as four Jedi entered the courtyard. ===Testing of the twins=== {{Quote|The scouts will bring Osha to your camp at midday.''"
"''Both girls. Her sister, too.|Mother Aniseya and Sol|}} Sarria stood with a bow lowered as the Jedi spoke with Aniseya, discussing the fact that the coven was training the twins. Although Mother Aniseya initially denied there being any children in the coven, the Jedi called out to the twins and Verosha came forward and then pointed out Mae-ho with Mother Aniseya's permission. The Jedi [[Sol]] then offered Verosha his [[Sol's lightsaber|lightsaber]] to examine and asked if she wished to be tested to become a Jedi. When Verosha responded positively, Mother Aniseya used the Force to effect the Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Torbin]]'s mind and demanded the Jedi leave if they wished him to be released; however, she relented when Verosha begged her to let the Jedi perform the test. Mother Aniseya then told the Jedi to expect the Verosha at their camp the next day, agreeing that Mae-ho would also attend the test when the Jedi demanded it. Sarria and the other warriors then remained on edge as the four outsiders left. At midday the following [[Standard day|day]], Sarria and another two scouts accompanied Korril and the twins through a [[forest]] to reach the Jedi's camp. Koril, Sarria, and another scout approached the Jedi first, then turned back to look at the twins as Koril ordered Mae-ho to take the test inside the Jedi's [[Polan GX-8|ship]] first. As Mae-ho took the test, Verosha waited outside the [[Starship|ship]] and noticed the [[Wookiee]] Jedi [[Kelnacca]] working on a [[Jedi outland speeder bike|speeder bike]]. As the child approached the Jedi, Sarria noticed her interest and kept pace with Verosha from a respectful distance. Mae-ho then emerged from the ship, having failed the test based on instruction from Mother Aniseya. Verosha then entered the ship to take the test, but chose to pass the test despite Mother Aniseya's instructions. ===Destruction of the coven=== {{Dialogue|Koril|Get everyone in the common room. Prepare for battle.|Aniseya|What is happening?|Sarria|The Jedi have breached the fortress again.|attr=Koril gives orders to Sarria as Mother Aniseya arrives|src=}} The twins then returned to the fortress and Verosha confirmed to Mother Aniseya that she wished to be a Jedi later that night. While Aniseya supported her daughter's wishes, Koril, Mae-ho and other members of the coven opposed letting Verosha leave. After Mae-ho disabled the lift up to the fortress, Koril ordered the scouts{{Acolyte|Choice}} {{AD|Disney+}} to arm themselves. Having learned that Verosha and Mae-ho's [[Reproduction|birth]] had been maniuplated through a [[Vergence|Force nexus]], Sol and Torbin arrived in search of the twins and scaled the fortress's walls to gain entry. Aware of the Jedi's return, Koril ordered Sarria to gather the coven in the common room and prepare for battle. Aniseya then approached the pair and questioned what was happening, so Sarria explained that the Jedi had returned before ordering two other scouts to follow and then departing. As Sol and Torbin entered the fortress's courtyard, Sarria and the other scouts gathered on a walkway above with their bows ready as Mother Aniseya and Koril confronted the Jedi below. Once the Jedi questioned the twins' origins, Sarria and the other scouts raised their bows prompting Torbin to draw his lightsaber once he noticed. Mae-ho then rushed into the courtyard crying for help, as she had started a [[fire]] outside Verosha's room that had grown out of control. As Koril and Torbin both prepared to attack one another, Mother Aniseya cried out and then began morphing her body into black smoke, causing Mae-ho to do the same. Sol then drove his lightsaber into the smoke, [[Death|killing]] Mother Aniseya. After Mae-ho mourned her mother and fled, Sarria and the other scouts opened fire on Torbin, who deflected their arrows while Koril attacked Sol. The fortress was then rocked by explosions caused by the spreading fire, after which Sol disarmed Koril. She then morphed into the same black smoke that Aniseya had, and when Torbin looked to the catwalk, Sarria and the scouts were also gone. Kelnacca then arrived in the courtyard, possessed by the witches, including those in the common room. The Wookiee attacked Sol and Torbin, injuring and incapacitating the Padawan, but was then freed from possession by Indara once she arrived. The ending of the possession killed the witches in the common room who had aided in controlling the Wookiee. Sol then saved Verosha from the fire and the Jedi left Brendok with her, while Mae-ho was presumed dead and left abandoned. ==Personality and traits== Sarria had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] worn braided between her [[tattoo]]ed head-tendril ridges. ==Equipment== Sarria wore dark green [[Clothing|robes]] with a brown shirt and a gray piece of chest [[armor]]. The scout used a bow and carried a hip quiver full of arrows. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I can finally announce… that I play Scout Sarria, the leader of the Scout Witches, in The Acolyte!!!!!! Been sitting on this one for a while; it really was a pinch-yourself experience, getting to play a small role in STAR WARS 😭😭 Huge thanks to @canadianderek for this opportunity and for championing me. And insane respect to my absolute squad of talented CFX, prosthetics and makeup artists. It took 4 hours in the chair every day to achieve this look. @jenkewley @msmeganthomas @caraparrymakeup @sammimasl you are all unbelievable. 🙌💖|Saskia Allen|{{Instagram|username=saskia_allen_|url=p/C8IBN39IHj2|name=[[Saskia Allen]]|date=2024-06-12|quote=I can finally announce… that I play Scout Sarria, the leader of the Scout Witches, in The Acolyte!!!!!! Been sitting on this one for a while; it really was a pinch-yourself experience, getting to play a small role in STAR WARS 😭😭 Huge thanks to @canadianderek for this opportunity and for championing me. And insane respect to my absolute squad of talented CFX, prosthetics and makeup artists. It took 4 hours in the chair every day to achieve this look. @jenkewley @msmeganthomas @caraparrymakeup @sammimasl you are all unbelievable. 🙌💖|archivefile=File:SaskiaAllen-Sarria-Instagram.png}}}} [[File:SaskiaAllenBTS-Sarria-Instagram.png|thumb|right|250px|It took four hours to apply Sarria's makeup and prosthetics.]] Sarria was portrayed by [[Saskia Allen]] during the character's first appearance in "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]]," the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 11]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the episode's release, the character was revealed in the first trailer for the show, which was released on [[March 19]], 2024.{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode but appeared in its subtitles and credits. The episode's audio description erroneously describes Sarria as wielding a [[staff]] rather than a bow when keeping pace with Verosha. The audio description for the show's seventh episode, "[[Choice]]," which aired on [[July 10]], 2024, erroneously misidentifies Sarria as Koril when the archers first arrive on the fortress's walkway. [[Jen Kewley]], [[Megan Thomas]], [[Cara Parry]], and [[Samanta Maslauskaite]] worked on the character with the character's make-up and prosthetics taking four hours to apply to Allen each day. The tendrils and tattoos match designs from a piece of concept art of the character [[Qi'ra]] titled "Kura X3 Version 1A" which was drawn by [[Luke Fisher]] for the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' Allen credits [[Derek Arnold]] with getting her the opportunity to work in ''[[Star Wars]]'' and has described Sarria as the leader of the coven's scouts. [[Martin Rezard]] sculpted Sarria's prosthetics.{{EmailCite|email=File:MartinRezard-AcolyteEmail.png|creator=Martin Rezard|date=2025-10-05}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Sarria}} *{{Acolyte|Choice}} *{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|lIF1B7S6ogY|The Acolyte | Awake | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|9DItelHk3ng|The Acolyte Launch Event Recap}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/destiny-episode-guide|text="Destiny" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-highlights-destiny|text=''The Acolyte'' Explained | Highlights from "Destiny"}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-music-michael-abels-interview|text=Scoring ''The Acolyte'': Composing for the Jedi, the Witches, and the Many Moods of the Stranger}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Sarria |ka=სარია }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Brendok coven]] [[Category:Scouts]] [[Category:Soldiers]] [[Category:Tosarvi]]
